note: Industry presence around Kalyani and Siliguri, West Bengal. These are places where industry is located, not job vacancies. Pin positions are approximate placements for orientation; check addresses with WBIIDC or the employer. Several sources are old and are dated on each item.

regions.name: Kalyani
regions.summary: Planned township north of Kolkata with three WBIIDC industrial parks, a large older industrial base in Gayespur, and a government ITI. Agro processing, chemicals, engineering and rail equipment show up most in official listings.
regions.job_search: Searched job portals on 16 Oct 2026 for ITI technician, fitter and electrician jobs in Kalyani. No current listings were found; the results were closed railway, PSU and research-institute notices elsewhere in the state.

sites.name: Kalyani Industrial Park, Phase I (WBIIDC)
sites.what: WBIIDC park at Chandmari Morh. An older listing gives 88 acres, 38 units, including Wales Distiller, Concept Rail Engineers, Synergy Industrial Services and Gapcon.

source.label: WBIIDC contact details and older Phase I page

sites.name: Kalyani Industrial Park, Phase II (WBIIDC)
sites.what: 134 acres, 20 industrial units, no land left. Agro-based: mustard oil, rice, dairy. Named units: Jyotirmoy Rice Mill, Nicco Biotech Ltd.

source.label: WBIIDC: Kalyani Industrial Park Phase II

sites.name: Kalyani Industrial Park, Phase III (WBIIDC)
sites.what: Beside the Barrackpore-Kalyani Expressway near Kalyani township.

sites.name: Gayespur industrial area
sites.what: Older industrial area with firms such as Tega India, Kolmark Chemicals and Phoenix Conveyor Belt India.

source.label: MSME Nadia district profile; company registry
source.date: Dated MSME profile; registry page about 2 years old

sites.name: Large units named in the MSME district profile
sites.what: Andrew Yule & Co., Kalyani Spinning Mill, Kalyani Breweries, Indian Oil Corporation, Telelink NICCO, EPCOS Ferrites. Some may have closed or changed since.

source.label: MSME Nadia district profile
source.date: Dated profile; check each unit is still operating

sites.name: Government ITI Kalyani
sites.what: Government ITI serving the Kalyani area. Training supply, not demand.

source.label: WB Department of Technical Education, ITI Kalyani

regions.name: Siliguri
regions.summary: Gateway to the North-East with a WBIIDC park at Dabgram, a small-industry estate on Sevoke Road and a growing logistics belt at Phulbari and Bagdogra. Food and tea processing, feed, plastics, engineering and logistics lead.
regions.job_search: Searched job portals on 16 Oct 2026 for ITI technician, electrician and fitter jobs in Siliguri. No current listings were found; one portal page describes moderate electrician demand but shows no active employers.

sites.name: Dabgram Industrial Park (WBIIDC)
sites.what: Set up in 1984, about 8 km from Siliguri on SH-12A. 106 acres, 48 units: engineering, cattle and poultry feed, plastic and PVC, food and tea processing.

source.label: WBIIDC: Dabgram Industrial Park
source.date: Current WBIIDC page; unit count may be older

sites.name: Siliguri Industrial Estate, Sevoke Road
sites.what: Small-industry estate with engineering, fabrication and printing units.

sites.name: Phulbari logistics and private industry belt
sites.what: Private industry growing along SH-12A and the Eastern Bypass; warehousing described as a fast-growing logistics corridor.

sites.name: Bagdogra airport cargo and logistics
sites.what: Airport serving as a trade and logistics hub for the North-East; a perishable cargo complex was sanctioned.

sites.name: Plastic engineering cluster (Jalpaiguri-Siliguri)
sites.what: An industry association lists 115+ member units in plastics and allied engineering.

announcements.title: Proposed industrial land near Dabgram (SJDA)
announcements.where: West of the Mahananda river near North Bengal Medical College
announcements.detail: About 1,000 acres proposed for acquisition, of which about 250 acres for industry, plus a 100-acre plot behind the Dabgram growth centre.
